newsitem.title: FRANCE: UNICEF, MSF lands relief in Uganda for east Zaire.
newsitem.headline: UNICEF, MSF lands relief in Uganda for east Zaire.

text.p: International relief agencies on Monday flew emergency aid to refugees fleeing fighting between Zairean troops and Rwanda-backed Tutsi rebels.

Medical charity Doctors without Borders (MsF) said two cargo planes left Europe in the morning for the Ugandan capital Kampala carrying 40 tonnes of medical equipment, tents and vehicles destined for eastern Zaire.
MSF said staff members had been sent to Uvira, Bukavu and Goma to try and locate several groups of Zairean refugees who have been stranded without care for 15 days.
Once the refugees were found, it would send other planes with food, water and medical equipment.
A Dutch air force plane chartered by UNICEF landed at Entebbe with 30 tonnes of emergency aid for refugees in east Zaire, the United Nations Children's Fund said.
It said in a statement that four more planes were due to ferry another 120 tonnes of aid in to the Ugandan capital later this week.

UNICEF said some of the aid was taken to Rwandan territory and medical teams were heading for the region, including an area on the border between Zaire and Tanzania to the south of the scene of the fighting.
